extras: Use at your own risk. This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: To allow developers to collect console output and uncaught exceptions from Obsidian plugins to aid in debugging.
problem: Developers need a reliable way to capture console output and uncaught exceptions from Obsidian plugins for debugging purposes.

relations.evidence: whose code was used to open the file explorer for selecting a folder outside Obsidian vaults.

summary: Logcollector intercepts and saves all console output and uncaught exceptions to a file, allowing developers to collect logs for debugging.
